g.text: From backend/app/db/models.py and Alembic migrations 0001 to 0006. Lines show each table's main parent; every foreign key is listed in its table.
Every table except qloo_cache carries project_id. Composite keys such as (campaign_id, project_id) -> campaigns(id, project_id) make cross-project references impossible in the database.
Nothing cascades: deleting a project archives it. On Supabase, Row Level Security limits each user to their own projects as defense in depth; embeddings and qloo_cache stay backend-only.
population_studies and social_simulations share their id with their run. Line ends: many at the child, one at the parent.
